name: research-skills
description: 研究者用的 agent skills 集合：一般讀者模擬、論文選題輔導、研究需求釐清訪談。

interface.shortDescription: 論文與研究工作流程的 agent skills
interface.longDescription: 給碩博士生與研究者使用的 skills：模擬一般讀者找出文章的理解斷點與作者意圖落差（general-reader-simulator）、從模糊想法收斂出可行的論文題目（thesis-topic-navigator）、以半結構化訪談釐清研究想法並產出會議記錄（clarifying-research-needs）。
defaultPrompt: Use $general-reader-simulator to simulate a non-expert reader and find the biggest comprehension gaps in my draft.
Use $thesis-topic-navigator to help me narrow my vague research interest into a feasible thesis topic.
Use $clarifying-research-needs to interview me and clarify my research idea.
